factCheck.notes: Verified against scraped pages 2026-10-20: Liberty Safe anchoring page (wood kit 1/4in holes at four points, washers, 9/16in socket; concrete 3/8in bit, hammer drill, 1/2in socket; tile cannot be anchored, cracks); Winchester bolt-down page (1/2in bit + 17mm socket in note vs 5/8in bit + 19mm socket in steps; shims to level; remove caps; concrete-only, no liability on carpet/wood, lag screws and pilot holes for wood); Master Lock do's/don'ts (read manual, only some safes designed for bolting, drill only where manual notes usually feet, never drill back of fireproof safe); Northwest Safe (post-tension cables, in-floor heating, utilities, rentals/HOA; steel plate larger than rough opening; most safes fire-tested with floor bolt holes, wall bolting can compromise fire protection; tall/shallow safes tip forward); Guardian Safe & Vault (steel plate min 1/4in wider than door frames, cables, small safes carried away; vacuum dust); AR15.com PT-slab thread (quote verbatim, scanner/stud/base fixes). Fire ratings stated only with certifier (UL/Intertek); renter section framed as general info, not legal advice; no products, no prices.
